title: a real page keeps its own type
note: The type pass raised every text below the stage's small size and the stage's sizes were given as the page's variables, so a real web page (own CSS, own type scale) had its nav wrap, its hero heading enormous and its prices break. A document that is a real page (its own face, a nav, sections, a centred column) is set at web scale and never type-raised; little apps keep the raise.

turns.say: render me a real webpage for a small coffee roaster
